My dear [Mrs Johns](../persons.html#772)
So many thanks for your kindness in doing me that nice couvre pied.

It was just what [Miss Walter](../persons.html#1462) had been assuring me that the sofa specially wanted for the winter and it brightens us up beautifully I am sure it has not been weather for going about this winter or rather autumn

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
